            sandbox.add_joint(tb, bracing, (bracing_x, ty), type='rigid')
            sandbox.add_joint(bb, bracing, (bracing_x, by), type='rigid')
        
        top_chord.append(tb)
        bot_chord.append(bb)
    
    # Anchor joints at lower y-positions to minimize torque
    sandbox.add_joint(top_chord[0], None, (WALL_X, anchor_top_y), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(bot_chord[0], None, (WALL_X, anchor_bot_y), type='rigid')
    
    return top_chord[0]
